column2: Trading Dice Game: a collectible dice game.
The river murmurs. The duel begins.

Victory: 2 crossings into the enemy camp OR 4 fights won. In a fight, attack decides; a higher-level die crushes the enemy creature it covers; at equal or lower level, its tile stays intact. The stats shown are those of the action.
+1 AP on a tile in its own camp
+1 AP when no ally is adjacent
+1 AP when an enemy is adjacent
+1 AP per adjacent ally (2 at most)
+1 AP per allied Bolduc on the board (2 at most)
+1 AP on a tile of 3 or less
Tiny but lively, she buzzes with discharges. A single pass is enough to wake a sleeping pylon.
A light breath that seems to have sprouted feathers. It rarely lands, but never misses a gust.
She carries pebbles a hundred times heavier than herself. Patience is her greatest strength.
It leaves crystal footprints in the snow. Its long ears catch the slightest crackle.
Born from a single drop of dew, it swims in the humid morning air.
Still brooded by the flames, it chirps sparks. It dreams of becoming a phoenix.
Born from a storm atop a copper tower, she crosses the board crackling. Each of her steps leaves a trail of sparks.
This prankster duck rides the air currents. They say it can announce a storm with a single quack.
Its shell shelters a miniature forest. Slow but unshakable, it advances remembering every stone.
It slides across the tiles as if on an ice floe. Its belly keeps the cold of the very first snows.
Its eight arms draw invisible currents. It likes damp tiles, where it moves without a sound.
Its flaming tail lights the board's nights. Cunning, it burns the paths it leaves behind.
Each roar cracks a lightning bolt. The elders say it slept in the very first storm cloud.
It glides through the heart of hurricanes without ruffling a feather. Where it passes, the sky makes way.
Its horn is a cliff and its step shakes the board. You don't go around it: you step aside.
Its tusks are millennia-old ice. It advances unhurried, and winter follows it.
It haunts the darkest tiles like the depths. It sniffs out an opponent leagues away.
His mane is a little sun. When he roars, the shadows of the board retreat.
It is the storm itself. A single wingbeat lights up the whole board.
Its breath carved the canyons of the world. It does not walk: it crosses.
Its back bears mountain ranges. Its patience outlasts empires.
Its breath freezes time. Every snowflake it leaves is an oath.
It sleeps beneath the ocean and dreams in tides. When it wakes, everything overflows.
The world's first flame. It burns without ever being consumed.
Divine power of storms: each of her spells tears the sky of Hackenia. Lightning affinity.
Divine fairy of springs and tides, she makes rain fall with a mere gesture. Water affinity.
Legendary mage of crackling arcana, always one flash away from victory. Lightning affinity.
Legendary heroine of Hackenia, as elusive as the breeze. Wind affinity.
Legendary force of the ancient lands, solid as rock and quick to strike. Earth affinity.
Eberien at the height of his art: the high-elf wizard now commands the entire winter. Ice affinity.
Floréa's faithful follower, now a legend, has learned to tame the waves. Water affinity.
Legendary bow of the Blaze: his arrows set the board ablaze. Fire affinity.
Little soul of bubbles and brooks, always in a good mood. Water affinity.
Craftsman of Hackenia with goldsmith's hands: he forges lightning the way others forge iron. Lightning affinity.
Wolf-headed fighter of the arid lands, fast and tenacious in melee. Earth affinity.
Gruff mountaineer of the hills, patient as stone. After a victory, he sometimes dozes off on the spot. Earth affinity.
High-elf wizard of Hackenia, Ice affinity.
Wood elf, archer and bard of Hackenia, Earth affinity.
Half-orc warrior of Hackenia, Water affinity.
Adventurer of Hackenia and follower of Floréa, Fire affinity.
Guardian of the lake's scarlet waters.
Faithful servant, wrapped in violet magic mist.
Pure elemental die: one tile of strength 2, placed without rolling. No creature appears.
Pure elemental die: two tiles of strength 3 and 2, placed without rolling. No creature appears.
Big-hearted young brawler, always the first to charge into the fray. No element.
Master of disguise: he passed himself off as an old farmer to observe the adventurers. Wind affinity.
Mischievous and precise, her needles graze their target before you see them leave. Water affinity.
Fiery-tempered mage, harsh at first but loyal to his own. Fire affinity.
Kala's old comrade, a seasoned warrior who holds the ground like a rampart. Earth affinity.
Warm adventurer who greets everyone with a friendly wave, as lively as the wind. Wind affinity.
When Alastor takes over, Max's eyes blaze with red lightning. A staircase shape climbing toward the opponent. Lightning affinity.
Dream demon who sows doubt in the minds of his prey. His compact block of four tiles crushes everything in its path. Lightning affinity.
Ice mage with his chin always held high. He spreads his frost in a T over four weaker tiles, ideal for covering ground. Ice affinity.
Elemental die charged with energy: three tiles in a straight line of strength 3, 4 and 4, placed without rolling. No creature appears. Two per deck at most.
Orven's cousin from the tundras: his fur has whitened with frost and his fangs bite like the cold. Ice affinity.
Ven's twin brother chose the blaze over the ice. Same raised chin, but a much hotter temper. Fire affinity.
Lost in the mist of the peaks, Max came back light as a gust... and just as quarrelsome. Wind affinity.
Velmarys stood guard on the docks for so long that the foam has tinted his armor. Water affinity.
When the storm rumbles, Bulbalina's bubbles fill with sparks and burst into tiny lightning bolts. Lightning affinity.
A statue of Gliska, carved in a temple of the winds. The air currents passing through it have awakened it. Wind affinity.
Caught in a blizzard, Pennedra's statue became covered in frost. She still waves, but with an icy gesture. Ice affinity.
Frolgor dozed off too close to a campfire: ever since, his leaves glow like embers. Fire affinity.
Silver automaton forged by Maebril in the image of the knight Jhimm. Electric arcs run across its armor. Lightning affinity.
Silver automaton in the image of Kala. Its metal arrows whistle in the wind. Wind affinity.
Silver automaton in the image of Grimgors, heavy as a boulder and just as stubborn. Earth affinity.
Silver automaton in the image of the Lake Guardian, keeper of the frozen springs. Ice affinity.
Silver automaton in the image of Eberien: its gears turn to the rhythm of the tides. Water affinity.
Silver automaton in the image of Bolduc, heated red-hot by its inner forge. Fire affinity.
A golden idol of Orcus buried beneath the mountain. They say the dream demon still whispers through it. Earth affinity.
Maebril's masterpiece: a golden automaton in his own image, cooled in eternal ice. Ice affinity.
The master of disguise passed himself off as a golden statue... and no one noticed a thing. Fire affinity.
Kayla raised to divine rank: a veil of pure wind surrounds her and carries her above the board. Wind affinity.
Hilam carved from the jade of the origins. Where he sets foot, the earth remembers. Earth affinity.
Eberien has crossed the threshold of eternity: his body has become frost crystal. Ice affinity.
A phoenix rose from Soryan's ashes: the divine flame now burns in the heart of this mage. Fire affinity.
Small crystal creature born from the lake's waters. It takes the color of every land it treads: multi-element, it always receives the terrain bonus, but never the neighbors'.
Mushroom healer of Dassom. Patient and rooted, he spreads his cap in a T to hold the ground. Earth affinity.
Explosive-tempered fighter who draws on all the elements at once. Multi-element: always the terrain bonus, never the neighbors', with slightly weaker tiles.
A Hydrelithe whose crystal has been charged with a single element. It loses its multi-element nature, but benefits from terrain and neighbor bonuses like other creatures. Affinity
A young archer trained by Bosco, whose arrows bear the mark of another element. Less powerful than his master, he remains fearsome from afar. Affinity
A Dassom myconide whose spores have been infused with another element. Like his healer cousins, he holds the ground with patience. Affinity
Zackarie dove into the abyss and came back changed: her needles now stitch the currents themselves. Water affinity.
By dint of faithful service, Sir Broom was covered in gold by his masters. He still sweeps... but with panache. No element.
A golden idol of Caleizis, struck by lightning atop a tower: a fragment of her power remained in it. Lightning affinity.
A golden statue of the fairy Pachié, in the heart of a sacred fountain. On rainy days, she comes alive to watch over the springs. Water affinity.
The eldest of the Hydrelithes: a colossus of bark and stone whose eyes shine like emeralds. Where she walks, islands float and waterfalls freeze. Earth affinity.
A miner from Berdésa, pickaxe on his shoulder and lamp on his brow. He knows every gallery... and every spider hiding in them. Earth affinity.
